name: specsheriff
description: Spec-anchored development: the skills, the SpecSheriff guidelines and the SpecSheriff tools that hold a specification, its tests and its code to one another.

claudeModel.title: Reviewer's model
claudeModel.description: The model the independent reviewer runs at, at your cost, at every commit that changes code. Default: opus. Any model name or alias Claude Code takes.

claudeFallbackModel.title: Reviewer's fallback model
claudeFallbackModel.description: The model the reviewer falls back to where the first is overloaded or not offered. Default: sonnet.

claudeEffort.title: Reviewer's reasoning effort
claudeEffort.description: The reasoning effort the reviewer runs at. Default: high, the lowest at which its verdicts were seen to agree from run to run.
